title: The Clock Is Ticking On David Ellison’s $111 Billion Media Empire Dream. Stalled Merger Will Start Costing Paramount $7 Million A Day On Sept 30.
title_zh: 大卫·埃里森 (David Ellison) 1110 亿美元媒体帝国梦想的时钟正在滴答作响。停滞不前的合并将从 9 月 30 日开始每天损失 700 万美元。
summary: David Ellison insists his blockbuster media merger is still on track, but a legal standoff with a coalition of state attorneys general is about to flip an abstract delay into a very concrete and very expensive problem.
summary_zh: 大卫·埃里森坚称，他轰动一时的媒体合并仍在进行中，但与州总检察长联盟的法律僵局即将将一个抽象的延迟转变为一个非常具体且非常昂贵的问题。

title: Morgan Stanley offering new ethereum, solana ETFs
title_zh: 摩根士丹利推出新的以太坊、solana ETF
summary: Scott Melker discusses how Morgan Stanley Investment Management (MS) launched its own ethereum (MSSE) and solana (MSOL) ETFs. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
summary_zh: Scott Melker 讨论了摩根士丹利投资管理公司 (MS) 如何推出自己的以太坊 (MSSE) 和 solana (MSOL) ETF。 《The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker》每天中午 12:00 播出。请关注您每天对加密事物的了解。

title: Larry Ellison Owns 40.6% of Oracle and Has Backstopped $40.4 Billion of a Media Deal. Here's Why That's an Oracle Shareholder's Problem.
title_zh: 拉里·埃里森 (Larry Ellison) 拥有甲骨文 40.6% 的股份，并支持了价值 404 亿美元的媒体交易。这就是为什么这是甲骨文股东的问题。
summary: The promise hasn't changed since December. The stock behind the man who made it has been cut by more than half.
summary_zh: 自去年 12 月以来，这一承诺从未改变。制造它的人背后的库存已经减少了一半以上。

title: Is ACN's Deal With Radisson for Booking App Launch a Growth Catalyst?
title_zh: ACN 与 Radisson 合作推出预订应用程序是增长催化剂吗？
summary: Accenture's AI-powered Radisson booking app in ChatGPT expands its agentic commerce reach and may unlock more travel-sector transformation opportunities.
summary_zh: 埃森哲在 ChatGPT 中采用人工智能的 Radisson 预订应用程序扩大了其代理商务范围，并可能释放更多旅游行业转型机会。

title: Blackstone (BX) Leads Kuwait Pipeline Deal In Record Foreign Investment
title_zh: Blackstone (BX) 引领科威特管道交易创下外国投资纪录
summary: Blackstone (NYSE:BX) is leading a consortium in a joint venture with Kuwait Oil Company. The deal is structured as a 20.5-year lease and leaseback of Kuwait's entire domestic and export pipeline network.
summary_zh: Blackstone（纽约证券交易所股票代码：BX）牵头组成一个财团，与科威特石油公司成立合资企业。该交易的结构为科威特整个国内和出口管道网络的 20.5 年租赁和回租。
